limitations: UT-175–180 call the existing private four-argument AcceptedAsync via reflection; this is helper coverage, not public HTTP coverage.

UT-211/217 inject DbUpdateConcurrencyException at Save and verify RV propagation; does not prove EF/SQL stale-row detection or database rollback.
Success cases verify service commands, read-back mocks and pending notice/outbox before Save/Commit; do not prove actual stored procedure inserts, schedule rows or persisted atomicity.

differences: Kỳ vọng KetQua lỗi 404, thực tế lỗi 403.
